printIssues.title: The Living Heritage of Princely India
printIssues.description: The inaugural international edition exploring palace restorations, royal archives of Rajasthan, and modern custodianship.

printIssues.title: Jewels, Horology & Haute Époque
printIssues.description: An in-depth inquiry into royal jewellery provenance, master watchmakers of the courts, and private connoisseurship.

printIssues.title: Winter Salons & The Art of the Table
printIssues.description: The winter banquet tradition, private cellar chronicles, and culinary dynasties of the Subcontinent.

archiveIssues.title: Volume I — Foundations of Grandeur
archiveIssues.summary: The inaugural volume documenting the restoration of Baoris, Mewar royal kitchens, and the bespoke Rolls-Royces of the Maharajas.
archiveIssues.featuredStory: Inside City Palace Jaipur: An Unbroken Lineage

archiveIssues.title: Special Retrospective — The Archival Portfolios
archiveIssues.summary: A private curated folio of glass-plate negatives from 1890–1930 documenting royal durbars and palace architectures.

archiveIssues.title: Monograph — Textiles, Weaves & Royal Looms
archiveIssues.summary: The royal patrons of Varanasi, Patan Patola, and Chanderi: preserving five centuries of handloom luxury.
archiveIssues.featuredStory: Zari, Silver & Gold: The Guilds of Varanasi

privateFiles.title: The Lost Cellars of Mewar & The Royal Recipes
privateFiles.subtitle: Unpublished manuscripts and oral histories from the royal kitchens of Udaipur
privateFiles.description: A 64-page confidential digital dossier translating royal court recipes, banquet etiquette of the 19th century, and the secret spice blends passed through four generations of royal khansamas.

privateFiles.title: The Golconda Emerald & Diamond Provenance Register
privateFiles.subtitle: Tracing 18 royal gems from the Nizam's treasury to modern European private vaults
privateFiles.description: Exclusively compiled with gemstone historians and museum archivists, featuring high-resolution gemological diagrams, archival receipts, and verified provenance records.

privateFiles.title: Coachbuilt: The 42 Bespoke Phantoms of the Maharajas
privateFiles.subtitle: Chassis numbers, original build sheets, and royal special orders from 1907 to 1939
privateFiles.description: The definitive archival dossier on the special-order Rolls-Royce and Bentley automobiles built for princely courts, complete with original coachbuilder correspondence.

collectorEditions.title: The Princely Lineages of the Subcontinent
collectorEditions.subtitle: A Collector's Compendium of Living Traditions, Architecture & Living Memory
collectorEditions.description: The Royal Gallerys 2026 Annual Collector's Edition: an encyclopedic, masterfully documented collector's volume of 320 pages featuring 14 royal dynasties, private photographic collections, genealogical lineages, and exclusive architectural drawings.
